harmonized_count: The number of cell-days with at least one detected fire in the month, on the MODIS-equivalent scale, so MODIS-era and VIIRS-era months can be compared.
uncertainty_interval: The range in which the harmonized count most likely lies, given the calibration error of the VIIRS-to-MODIS mapping.
baseline_median: The middle value of the harmonized counts for this calendar month across all complete years in the baseline period, where half the years were lower and half higher.
anomaly: How far the month's harmonized count is from the baseline median for the same calendar month, shown as a difference and as a percentage.
z_score: The number of standard deviations by which the month's harmonized count lies above or below the baseline mean for the same calendar month.
percentile_rank: The share of baseline years whose harmonized count for this calendar month was at or below the selected month's count.
